name: Navigation
purpose: Tab controller (UITabBarController / Android BottomNavigation). One items list morphs TabBar ↔ collapsible rail ↔ sidebar. Stack chrome is NavigationTitle, not this component.
scenarios: Drive AppShell chrome with one destination list across phone, tablet, and desktop
Collapse the tablet rail without mounting a second navigation tree
Keep the same aria-current destination as the window or host container resizes
Keep a long desktop list (10+) behind More on compact instead of a second nav tree

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

items.description: NavigationItem[]: { value, label }. Compact pins the first maxCompactItems plus More; overflow lists in the sidebar form.

header.description: Sidebar brand / chrome above the destination list. Official child: TitleBar (logo+title+subtitle). Formal DoD: visible in rail/sidebar morph (≥48rem); hidden in compact TabBar — do not duplicate brand chrome on mobile.

footer.description: Sidebar foot chrome below the destination list. Official child: NavAccountCard (avatar | username/nickname | logout). Formal DoD: visible in rail/sidebar (≥48rem); hidden in compact TabBar. When set, the collapse toggle is not rendered.

activeValue.description: Value of the current destination; sets aria-current.

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial destination when activeValue is omitted.

onSelect.description: Called with the destination value when an item is activated. Does not push a stack.

maxCompactItems.description: Compact tab-bar pins before More. Capped at 4. Extra items overflow.

collapsible.description: Render the tablet collapse toggle. CSS hides it on compact and desktop. Ignored when footer is set — logout owns the foot chrome.

onCollapsedChange.description: Called when the tablet rail collapsed state changes.

states.name: expanded
states.description: Sidebar form shows labels; compact tab-bar form always shows labels.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Tablet rail hides labels; items keep accessible names. Compact ignores this state.

antiPatterns: Do not pass a Sidebar and a TabBar for the same destination set — that is two components, not a three-end morph.
Do not use matchMedia or a device picker to swap navigation trees.
Do not drop destinations on compact; extra items go behind More and list in the sidebar form.
Do not put the current screen title or back control here; that is NavigationTitle (the stack).
Do not show a logo+title+subtitle brand header on the compact TabBar — use TitleBar in header; CSS hides __header below 48rem by design.
Do not permanently hand-roll Stack+BrandMark+Typography for the sidebar brand — use TitleBar.
Do not show account/logout chrome on the compact TabBar — use NavAccountCard in footer; CSS hides __footer below 48rem.
Do not wrap Navigation + account card as siblings outside the landmark — put the card in footer so only __list scrolls.
Do not use the logout control as a collapse toggle.

keyboard: Tab moves through items, More, and the tablet toggle
Enter/Space activates the focused item; Escape closes More
a11y.focus: One landmark stays in the tab order at every breakpoint; CSS hide of the toggle removes it from painting, not from the accessibility tree until display:none applies.
a11y.labeling: The nav is labelled via the label prop; collapsed items keep aria-label text.

responsive.strategy: One DOM tree. Compact is a tab bar of up to four pins plus More. Overflow items list in the sidebar form at 48rem. No second navigation tree.

breakpoints.compact: Up to four pins plus More; extra destinations open in a sheet above the bar. Header / TitleBar and footer / NavAccountCard are not presented (display:none).
breakpoints.medium: Vertical collapsible sidebar listing every destination, including overflow. Header and footer are visible and pinned; only __list scrolls. Collapsed rail hides TitleBar / account text via CSS. Collapse toggle omitted when footer is set.
breakpoints.large: Persistent 16rem sidebar listing every destination; More and the collapse toggle hide. Header and footer are visible and pinned; only __list scrolls.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only; item order follows the document direction; the collapse chevron mirrors under [dir=rtl].

mechanics: Navigation is the tab controller (UITabBarController / BottomNavigation): one items list, one DOM tree. Named-container CSS on AppShell restyles that tree — compact is a tab bar (first N pins + More), medium is a 12rem collapsible rail, large is a 16rem sidebar. onSelect(value) switches the current destination and must not push a stack; stack chrome is NavigationTitle plus useTabStacks. Optional header hosts TitleBar (official sidebar brand). Optional footer hosts NavAccountCard (official account + logout); when footer is set the collapse toggle is omitted. Scroll contract: AppShell __nav and Navigation __frame do not scroll; only __list is the scrollport; header and footer stay pinned. Chrome row: __header uses min-block-size calc(var(--cu-control-size-active) + 2 * var(--cu-space-1)) to align with NavigationTitle; ≥48rem __frame top is safe-area only. Formal DoD: __header / __footer visible only in rail/sidebar; compact TabBar hides them. Do not mount Sidebar and TabBar for the same destinations.
usage: Import Navigation from the React or Vue umbrella. Do not import workspace:* or packages/components-react/src.
Pass label and one items list. Bind activeValue and onSelect; selecting a tab must not push.
Place the same Navigation node in AppShell navigation / #navigation so CSS morphs TabBar to sidebar.
Pair with NavigationTitle and useTabStacks so back pops only the active tab stack.
Optional: bind collapsed and onCollapsedChange for the tablet rail. CSS hides the toggle on compact and desktop. Omit footer when you still want the toggle.
Optional sidebar brand: pass TitleBar as header (React) or #header (Vue). Do not hand-roll Stack+BrandMark for the brand row.
Optional sidebar account foot: pass NavAccountCard as footer (React) or #footer (Vue). Do not wrap the card as a sibling outside Navigation.

exports.name: Navigation
exports.description: Tab controller that morphs TabBar, rail, and sidebar from one items list.

exports.name: splitNavigationItems
exports.description: Same compact/overflow split the component uses. Cap is 4 pins.

exports.name: NavigationItem
exports.description: One root destination. value is the onSelect argument.

exports.name: NavigationProps
exports.description: Public props for Navigation, including onSelect and onCollapsedChange.
